commands: echo '=== STALE TERMS TRACKED ==='; git grep -n -i -E 'handoff|fresh chat|implementation not started|not implemented|integration/convergence|feature/eink-clay-status|temporary prompt|superseded|obsolete|deprecated' -- README.md AGENTS.md docs web/README.md || true
echo '=== TODO FIXME HACK WIP TRACKED ==='; git grep -n -i -E 'TODO|FIXME|XXX|HACK|WIP|TEMPORARY|TBD|PLACEHOLDER|NOT IMPLEMENTED|IMPLEMENTATION NOT STARTED' -- ':!web/pnpm-lock.yaml' || true

echo '=== RETIRED FILE REFERENCES ==='; git grep -n -i -E 'OUTPUT_EXECUTION_ARCHITECTURE|STAGE27C_CROWPANEL_BRINGUP|INTEGRATION_CONVERGENCE|FRESH_CHAT_BOOTSTRAP|EINK_UI_HANDOFF|CONTINUATION_PLAN' || true; echo '=== BRANCH REFERENCES ==='; git grep -n -i -E 'mvp/environment-controller|integration/convergence-2026-08|feature/eink-clay-status' || true

echo '=== SERIAL DEFAULTS/REFS ==='; git grep -n -E '/dev/cu[.](usbserial|usbmodem)-[0-9]+' || true; echo '=== GROWBOX PREPROCESSOR DEFINES ==='; git grep -n -E '#(ifndef|ifdef|define)[[:space:]]+GROWBOX_[A-Z0-9_]+' -- src lib components || true

echo '=== MARKDOWN LOCAL LINKS ==='; git grep -n -E '\[[^]]+\]\([^)]*[.]md([#][^)]*)?\)' -- '*.md' || true; echo '=== REFERENCES TO HISTORIC WORKFLOWS ==='; git grep -n -E 'stage11-format-cleanup|stage27c-storage-gate|ml-dagger-stage11-resume' || true; echo '=== FINAL STATUS ==='; git status --short
